column1: # M11-complexity-T2 (D-0141). Runs the DEBUG pass does not make, each with its measured
# reason; the lane prints every one of them on every debug pass. TAB-separated:
# name, config (`*` for all), reason. An entry is a cost the pass cannot afford, never a
# failure hidden: the plain pass still runs the instance in every configuration.

column3: BAGUETTE_DEBUG costs this instance 6.1 GB and 218 s at 1 500 nodes (default config) and 6.1 GB, 248 s with proof-only learning, rc 0 and no invariant fired under a 32 GB cap (f9bf6c4 and a8d2924, 2026-11-18); under the 4 GB cap it dies in the GC
